notes.title: Update notes for Sep. 25 (v1.2.0)
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added hide tutorial text and stamina boost on first enemy chase.
[*] Reduced difficulty in ball pit.
[*] Added "minigame" to try catch the balloon on the city.
[*] Reduced ambush probability on act 1.
[*] Improved big circus tent outside collisions to better match how it looks.
[*] Increased labyrinth toy speed on act 2.
[*] Reduced hint text size.
[*] Fixed bugs related to the enemy being able to go into the bonfire salt circle.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the clown to kill you when you were hiding inside a tube.
[/olist]

notes.title: Mind the Clown - v0.5.0 major update
notes.notes: [h1]v0.5.0 Major Update[/h1][p]This is a major update that aims to improve audio, graphics and difficulty before the full release of the game.[/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][list][*][p]Checkpoints.[/p][/*][*][p]More time until clown appearances.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked game intro.[/p][/*][*][p]Animated cinematics for intro and circus transition.[/p][/*][*][p]Adaptive music in the circus.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved sound design.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced headbob.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina system.[/p][/*][*][p]New poster designs.[/p][/*][/list][p]The full game is launching in less than a month, any feedback on the game (especially about difficulty) is greatly appreciated 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]I am glad to present you part of the circus cast:[/p][p][/p][h2]Wes Hadley - The Strongman[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604762/cd08386d0b697aec1113354d2c2b9f1c43daef69.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Lois McGee - The Magician[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604762/adb7dc8d084c732dde74b7b20dcecba659f4b155.png"][/img][/p]
